title: My roster
subtitle: Mark the agents and uniforms you own. This powers your team builder and suggestions.
localNote: Your selections are saved on this device. Sign in to sync across devices.

reset.title: Reset selections
reset.text: Deletes the teams built for the chosen mode. Roster and other modes are kept.

help.title: My roster
help.text1: Tap a uniform to mark or unmark it. An agent counts as owned if you own at least one of its uniforms.
help.text2: Use the backup to move your selections to another device without an account.

ctpDrop: Drag or tap a CTP to equip
ctpArmed: CTP selected: tap one of your characters to equip it.
